title: Cells of the walking adjunction relative to one triangle
statement:
Use simplicial sets, nerves, standard simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A simplicial category has simplicial hom-sets, identity vertices and strictly associative unital simplicial composition; a simplicial functor preserves this structure. For a simplicial set $X$, define its right cone $X^{\triangleright}$ by adjoining a last vertex $*$: its $r$-simplices are the constant simplex at $*$ and the disjoint union of $X_j$ for $0\leq j\leq r$, with the copy of $X_j$ occupying the initial $j+1$ vertices and all remaining vertices equal to $*$. Operators restrict or repeat the initial block, giving the constant apex when that block becomes empty. Define $2[X]$ to have objects $0,1$, hom $2[X](0,1)=X$, identity homs $\Delta^0$ and reverse hom empty. Define $3[X]$ to have objects $0,1,2$, homs $3[X](0,1)=X$, $3[X](1,2)=\Delta^0$, $3[X](0,2)=X^{\triangleright}$, identity homs $\Delta^0$ and all other homs empty, with composition $X\to X^{\triangleright}$ the initial inclusion.

Let $\mathsf{Adj}$ be the simplicial category obtained by applying the nerve to each hom-category of the free strict $2$-category generated by objects $+,-$, arrows $\ell:+\to-$, $u:-\to+$, unit $\eta:1_+\to u\ell$ and counit $\epsilon:\ell u\to1_-$, with the two triangle identities. Let $\beta$ denote its $2$-simplex with successive edges $\ell\eta,\epsilon\ell$ and long edge the identity at $\ell$. The simplicial subcategory $A_0\subseteq\mathsf{Adj}$ generated under composition, faces and degeneracies by $\ell,u,\eta,\epsilon,\beta$ has the following freeness property: a simplicial functor from $A_0$ into any simplicial category is determined by arbitrary images of those generators having the indicated boundaries, with no additional relations beyond those boundaries and the simplicial-category axioms.

There is an increasing sequence $A_0\subseteq A_1\subseteq\cdots$ of simplicial subcategories with union $\mathsf{Adj}$. Each inclusion $A_i\to A_{i+1}$ is a pushout of a finite coproduct of maps of the following two types: (i) $2[\Lambda_k^n]\to2[\Delta^n]$ with $n\geq2$ and $0<k<n$; (ii) $3[\partial\Delta^m]\to3[\Delta^m]$ with $m\geq1$. Here $\partial\Delta^m$ is the union of all proper faces. For every attachment of type (ii), the attaching map into $A_i$ sends the objects $0,1,2$ to $b,+,-$ for $b\in\{+,-\}$, sends $1\to2$ to $\ell$, sends the last vertex $m$ in the $0\to1$ hom to $ua$, sends the cone apex in the $0\to2$ hom to $a$, and sends the cone edge from $m$ to that apex to $\epsilon a$, where $a=1_-$ if $b=-$ and $a=\ell$ if $b=+$.
